title: 56-bit-VA gated Y-cluster joint-2X 6-window birthday search on secp256k1 at 123.485095908309281 (per-generator i.i.d. X, MX=8)

claims.statement: For uniform production secp256k1 Q=[x]P, the classical cold gated grouped stored-leaf birthday search of proof.md on a 56-bit-VA generator/relay/home machine recovers x with unconditional single-run probability at least 0.39 over the challenge and fresh algorithm coins. One coordinator first draws a 128-bit RNDR coin u and halts with no output unless u < K_GATE = 132893055410347227215214067265892819315 (p_gate = K_GATE/2^128 = 0.390537590; GATE = 256 instructions charged on every run); otherwise it runs q1 = 17,170,000,000 batches in G = 2048 power-law groups (m_g = floor(q1*(g/2048)^(24/32))) on 2^68 generators (2^58 clusters of 1024, each generator drawing MX=8 independent uniform permanent scalars), 2^42 relays and 2^84 homes (CAP_H = 164,136,470,183,936 records). The opened run succeeds with probability lo_run >= 0.998623487827 (Chen-Stein on the good-collision count, success.md 6.1-6.6), so with exact lo_run p_gate * lo_run >= 0.39000001 > 0.39. Expected total work E_total = 256 + p_gate * E_run is at most 2^123.485095908309281 units of 1000 scalar AArch64 instructions (opened run E_run <= 2^124.841563 units, at most 74.7092 instructions per leaf of S = 2^128.584133). Peak memory at most 2^137.0009 bytes; opened-run preprocessing at most 2^117.1336 units, included in E_run; no advice. certificate.py checks the ledger, the 5.1 itemizations, the rate bounds and the census figures.

experiments.purpose: Checks Y-chain generation, the MX=8 6-window leaf kernels against bit-exact models, table builds and mutant rejections (experiment.py, sites.py); the 56-bit-VA machine with Y ring, address trace, completion and mutant rejections (machine.py); the gate; toy-curve (p = 43, r = 31) Chen-Stein cases; and the kernel counts against certificate.py.
